summary: Comprehensive testing of CRM and Events features completed. All features working correctly: Login with email/password, CRM Direct/Corporate client creation with badges, Events multi-day date selector, and company name display in event titles for corporate clients.
passed_tests: CRM: Create direct client with name, email, phone
CRM: Direct clients appear in list
CRM: Create corporate client with company name, RNC, and multiple contacts
CRM: Corporate client with empty contact email allowed
CRM: Corporate clients show 'Corporate' badge in list
CRM: Direct/Corporate client type toggle in form
Events: Create event linked to corporate client
Events: Events endpoint returns client_info with company_name and client_type
Events: Company name appears in event title for corporate clients (e.g., 'Tech Solutions SA - Conferencia Anual 2026')
Events: Start Date and End Date fields appear when multi-day enabled
Events: Calendar date picker opens and allows date selection
Events: End Date calendar works correctly
Events: Create multi-day event with is_booking=true and end_date
Events: Multi-day events appear correctly in list with valid date ranges
seed_data_creation: Test data created with TEST_ prefix for clients and events, cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: All CRM and Events features working correctly. CRM supports Direct and Corporate client types with proper badges. Corporate clients can have company_name, RNC, and multiple contacts. Events linked to corporate clients show 'CompanyName - EventName' format in the title. Multi-day booking toggle enables Start Date and End Date fields with working calendar pickers. Google OAuth uses Emergent Auth and cannot be fully tested in preview environment.
